requirements.text: The player can move left and right using the arrow keys.
requirements.check: After pressing left or right, the player's horizontal position changes in the expected direction.

requirements.text: Collecting a gem increases the score by one.
requirements.check: After the player collects one gem, the displayed score increases by exactly one.

requirements.text: Collecting five gems triggers the win state.
requirements.check: After five gems are collected, the game displays the win state.

requirements.text: The player can restart the game after winning.
requirements.check: Activating restart returns the game to its initial state and resets the score to zero.
